statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because verified U.S. futures are firmer and no persistent live NQ mean-reversion failure is independently established; hawkish rates and Middle East escalation keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; the next concentrated risk checkpoint is the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and subsequent cash-open price discovery.
headline: Firmer futures and easing oil keep Tail low while rates and geopolitics sustain extreme Stress
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq futures up 0.7%, a seven-week-high dollar and elevated front-end Treasury yields after the Fed hike. Brent was down 1.8% at 06:32 UTC despite broader Middle East escalation. Fresh Finviz semiconductor and megacap breadth is supportive context, but live NQ failed-retracement structure is not independently verified.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 published clock-hours, Tail rose around the FOMC sequence, peaked at 25% at 20:00 UTC on September 16, then decayed to 19% by 06:00 UTC as the path became less one-way.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low conditionally through early Europe, rises into WATCH around the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and cash-open discovery, then decays if price discovery becomes two-way. Firm rates and geopolitical risks keep Stress elevated.

forecast.analysis: Verified Nasdaq futures were 0.7% higher, oil was easing and fresh Finviz tech breadth was supportive; firm yields, dollar strength and Middle East escalation keep Stress extreme while live NQ failed-retracement structure remains unverified.
